name: RunExcelMacroNode
label: Run Excel Macro
description: Runs a specified VBA macro in the provided Excel workbook.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WorkbookInstance
fields.label: Workbook Instance
fields.description: The Excel Workbook containing the macro to run.

fields.name: MacroName
fields.label: Macro Name
fields.description: The name of the macro to run (e.g., 'Module1.MyMacro').

fields.name: Argument1
fields.label: Argument 1
fields.description: Optional first argument to pass to the macro.

fields.name: Argument2
fields.label: Argument 2
fields.description: Optional second argument to pass to the macro.

fields.name: Argument3
fields.label: Argument 3
fields.description: Optional third argument to pass to the macro.

fields.name: MacroResult
fields.label: Macro Result
fields.description: The result returned by the macro, if any.
